prepare_dataset_ogb_wikikg2: prepare the ogbl-wikikg2 dataset by downloading, splitting triples, and saving train/valid/test arrays as numpy files
prepare_dataset_ogb_biokg: prepare the ogbl-biokg dataset by indexing triples across entity types and saving mapped arrays as pickle files
prepare_dataset: prepare a conventional KBC dataset by mapping entities and relations to unique IDs and creating filtered metric skip lists
index_triples_across_type: index triples across different entity types by assigning type indices and offsetting entity IDs per type
run_preprocess_datasets: run the main script to preprocess one or more datasets including ogbl-wikikg2, ogbl-biokg, or custom graph datasets
